blocks.html: Dr. Shawn Muldoon graduated from the University of Houston College of Optometry and now serves as an adjunct assistant professor at the Cornea and Contact Lens Service within the college. Due to his professorship within the university and his membership in the American Optometric Association, the Texas Optometric Association, and the Harris County Optometric Society, Dr. Muldoon is committed to remaining current on state of the art technology and procedures. Dr. Muldoon performs a number of different services, including eye examinations, optical frames dispensary, and dry eye/tear tests. He specializes in hard to fit contact lenses, ocular disease, laser vision correction, and primary care optometry. With a caring and friendly demeanor, Dr. Muldoon knows how to put patients at ease and make them feel well informed about their treatment. When he is not working, Dr. Muldoon enjoys cycling, soccer, and spending time with his family.
